explanation_short: The KNN model achieved the highest performance metrics, with an R2 score of 0.81717 and an RMSE of 0.11318, outperforming all other benchmark models.
explanation_full: The KNN model was identified as the best benchmark model, achieving an R2 score of 0.81717 and a Mean Squared Error (MSE) of 0.012810. When comparing model performance, KNN significantly outperformed DT (R2: 0.56045) and SVM (R2: 0.73241). Furthermore, the top correlated features with HPR are VFA (0.7984), Butyrate (0.7827), and Acetate (0.7641), indicating their strong predictive power for Hydrogen Production Rate (HPR).
